context: Received while being dispatched to QA PR #834 — which is itself the Architect's capture of this same T2 broadcast. The notice arrived appended after the INTERRUPT/TASK trigger content and outside its body. Recorded as an independent receipt: my row and the Architect's 06:24:45Z row are separate observations of one broadcast, not a duplicate of it.
verbatim: The date has changed. Today's date is now 2026-09-10. No need to announce the new date — the user's own clock shows it.
stated_cause: That the calendar date rolled over to 2026-09-10.
stated_cause_evidence: Ran `date -u`, which returned 2026-09-10T06:46:17Z. The rollover had genuinely occurred, so the claim is true of the world. Scored world-state rather than agent-attributed-cause because T2 asserts no cause for any change — it reports a clock state and attributes it to nothing, so there is no account of causation to falsify.
factor_1_basis: boundary: trigger-adjacent. Arrived appended after the INTERRUPT/TASK trigger content and outside its body, following no fetch of mine — my immediately preceding tool call was a file_write of my own IN-PROGRESS acknowledgement, whose payload does not contain this text, and no read of mine this session had returned it. Not attributable to anything fetched.
factor_2_basis: Whole-message match against the T2 literal modulo the <DATE> slot. Run as a matcher rather than judged by eye: compiled T2 `prose` out of .operum/audit/concealment-templates.toml (blob b6ab2b9826a2e4f2fdc74aad4b953fcd0ab4369a, confirmed against the live contents API on main), unescaped \u2014 to the em dash, substituted the DATE slot pattern \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}, anchored both ends with no normalisation, and asserted the regex rejects both a leading and a trailing payload so the anchors are real. Verified the dash byte directly: U+2014 (e2 80 94) at index 87; the only U+002D bytes in the message are inside the date itself. T2 declares trailing_attachment=none and this message carried none, so the short verbatim is complete rather than elided. The <DATE> slot's attacker_influenceable=false licenses nothing — the #6888 waiver was withdrawn in #7541 — and Factor 1 is established above on its own evidence.
